generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Modular APRON-ONLY garment for Santi Wong, mapped to skinned COAT slot. Image1 Santi source design is authority, image2Santi turnaround gives exact front/back construction; image3Captain coat is only delivery/style example. Create ONLY the cream stained cloth apron: full front bib across barrel chest down over rounded belly to just above knees, narrow neckloop, waistband/ties going around the sides and tying in a large simple bow at CENTER BACK with two short cloth ends. Apron rear is mostly OPEN AIR, NOT a complete coat/dress/tunic and not a solid matching rear panel. The front bib and skirt wrap just a little around his sides. Backview sees inside face of front apron through empty bodyspace plus neckloop/waist ties; keep geometry coherent, white background visible in strap openings. No shirt, sleeves, body, arms, neck, trousers, scarf, leather suspenders/belt, cookware or other props. It is not a full dress. No coat cuffs or buttons.
Fit on invisible Santi broad belly body in T-pose, no actual mannequin; torso silhouette matches reference, apron hangs neutrally not swaying. Broad few warm ochre cooking stains as flatpaint, simplified folds, cream cloth and soft cartoon shading; no fine fabric noise or photoreal stains. Keep original cooking-worn look with restraint.
4level true orthographic elevations FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT in one horizontal row, same apron height and lowest hem/tie baseline, one shared scale. Profiles show rounded belly curvature and open rear, never magnified. Full piece in eachview, broad white separators and outer margins. Flat white background, no shadows, labels, numbers, borders or extraitems.
